accordion.heading: Onboarding checklist
accordion.body: Collect company details, assign an owner, review security documentation, and approve the agreement before activation.

accordion.heading: How risk reviews work
accordion.body: Assess data access, business criticality, and compliance documentation. Record findings and assign follow-up actions to your relationship owner.

accordion.heading: Preparing for a renewal
accordion.body: Review performance and spend 30 days before expiry, confirm business requirements, and record your renewal decision.
